name: node-mutations
body: The `apg node add|update|rm` arms in src/node_cmd.rs (`cmd_node` dispatches them). `add` refuses when the FQN already exists; `update` reads the existing node, mutates only body/properties (name immutable), and writes while keeping all out/in edges; `rm` removes the file and strips incident edges from every referencing file in one atomic mutation.
